execution.objective: Define Builder output lifecycle and qualification governance for generated, materialized, and delivery-candidate artifacts.
success_criteria: Resolve the LEAP-002 derived-artifact lifecycle question using the certified Builder contract and execution doctrine.
Define ownership, provenance, meaning, and allowed transitions for generated, materialized, qualified, and delivery-candidate artifacts.
Reconcile builder delivery entries with package paths, hashes, qualification records, and builder evidence.
Use the identical LEAP-002 generated/materialized archives as a case study; retain both unless authoritative lifecycle evidence establishes their roles.
Specify how unqualified outputs are represented and prevent them from being treated as certified or deliverable.
Define required lineage and manifest evidence for Builder outputs.
Do not modify or execute Builder scripts; do not regenerate, overwrite, move, archive, or delete package artifacts.
Do not read secret values or modify runtime, database, deployment, or Supabase files.
Any governance materialization or cleanup requires a separate, itemized authority.

unlocks: A separately authorized Builder-output governance materialization WCS.
A separate itemized cleanup WCS only if lifecycle evidence supports cleanup.
